structured.approach: BE-03 asks me to confirm that any required database changes are complete. I took the procedure from the backend-steps skill (reads feat.tasks and feat.design, writes task.db_changes). I read both inputs in full and looked for anything about storage in the scope (A1), the decisions (DD-1, DD-3), the non-functional needs (NF-10), what would reopen the platform design (A8), and the files the Backend tasks TSK-05 and TSK-06 are allowed to change. I then checked the ap_aging checkout myself: I listed its files, searched it for database and migration terms, and read aging.py and __init__.py. This backed up the tool view. Both the design and the repository say no database change is needed, so I wrote the output as a short record of that check. It has no blocking questions. I did not use the verifier subagent because the output makes only a few statements, and I checked each one against the source I read.

claims.text: The design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope. The in-scope data (paid_date key, reject reason, delay history, risk map, overdue rows, CT-1 JSON) is held in memory.
DD-1 says the feature adds no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage. It uses only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS.
Under NF-10 every new function is pure and in memory: no I/O, no network and no changes to its inputs. A storage or network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01.
The Backend tasks TSK-05 (overdue_with_risk) and TSK-06 (overdue_rows_to_json) only change src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and tests/test_overdue.py. TSK-06 adds no transport layer.
ap_aging has no database. No migrations exist and none are needed.
The repository has no migration, schema or SQL file. A search for sqlite, database, migration, CREATE TABLE, sqlalchemy and psycopg found no match. aging.py imports only datetime, decimal and typing.
The ap_aging package version today is 1.4.0.

open_questions: Non-blocking, carried over: DQ-1 (feat.design D3) asks which production component carries CT-1 from ap_aging to ap_portal. If the answer adds storage or a transport, DES-01 would reopen and this step would run again.
structured.summary: No database changes are needed for FEAT-ZD-48600 in ap_aging. The design rules out storage and migrations: A1 puts them out of scope, DD-1 adds no storage and NF-10 keeps the new functions pure and in memory. TSK-05 and TSK-06 only touch in-memory Python functions. The repository has no database, schema or migration code. task.db_changes records this check with no blocking questions, and BE-04 can start.
